final: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND replacement_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating) SELECT AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_of_rating_durations, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_rating_ratios FROM per_rating
